pi.name: Tathagata Srimani
pi.affiliation: Electrical and Computer Engineering, Carnegie Mellon University
bio: Dr. Tathagata Srimani directs the NEXUS Research Group. His research focuses on improving the energy-efficiency and throughput of computing systems hardware through cross-stack advances in semiconductor technologies, heterogeneous integration, circuit design, and computer architecture.

He was elevated to IEEE Senior Member in 2025 and received an NSF Faculty Early Career Development (CAREER) Award in 2026. His work on foundry monolithic 3D integration received the Best Student Paper Award at the 2023 IEEE Symposium on VLSI Technology.
